notebooks.title: 几何序列与加权和
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
k = sp.symbols('k', integer=True, nonnegative=True)
z = sp.symbols('z', nonzero=True)

cells.code:
a=sp.Rational(1,2)
N=8
partial=sum(a**i for i in range(N+1))
X=1/(1-a/z)
print('记录0到3:',[a**i for i in range(4)])
print('N/项数/有限和/小数:',N,N+1,partial,sp.N(partial,12))
print('无限和/尾项:',X.subs(z,1),2-partial,sp.N(2-partial,12))
print('变换（ROC模z大于1/2）:',sp.factor(X))
print('delta变换:',1)
for a_value in [1,-1]:
    print('边界a/前五个部分和:',a_value,[sum(a_value**i for i in range(n+1)) for n in range(5)])

notebooks.title: 同分式与两种收敛域
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
q=sp.symbols('q')
z=sp.symbols('z', nonzero=True)

cells.code:
a=sp.Rational(1,2)
right=1/(1-a/z)
left=-(z/a)/(1-z/a)
print('两分式相减:',sp.simplify(right-left))
print('右侧前四项:',[a**i for i in range(4)])
print('左侧k=-1,-2,-3:',[-a**i for i in [-1,-2,-3]])
print('右侧z1/左侧z1/4:',right.subs(z,1),left.subs(z,sp.Rational(1,4)))
print('各自截断核对:',sum((a/1)**i for i in range(81)),sp.N(-sum((sp.Rational(1,4)/a)**i for i in range(1,81)),12))
print('同一分式在z1,a=-1的代数值（非边界级数和）:',sp.Rational(1,2))

notebooks.title: 单边延迟与非零初值
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
z=sp.symbols('z', nonzero=True)

cells.code:
a=sp.Rational(1,2)
q=4
Y0=a*q/(1-a/z)
left=q+Y0/z
right=q+sum(q*a**(i+1)*z**(-i-1) for i in range(16))
print('零输入初值响应0到3:',[q*a**(i+1) for i in range(4)])
print('Y0/延迟式:',sp.factor(Y0),sp.factor(left))
print('z2处原移位前17项/完整值:',sp.N(right.subs(z,2),12),left.subs(z,2))
U=1/(1-1/z)
Y=sp.factor(U/(1-a/z))
parts=2/(1-1/z)-1/(1-a/z)
print('阶跃分式拆分余量:',sp.simplify(Y-parts))
print('阶跃输出0到3:',[2-a**i for i in range(4)])
print('延迟两格脉冲变换:',z**(-2))

notebooks.title: 递推卷积与终值边界
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
z=sp.symbols('z', nonzero=True)

cells.code:
a=sp.Rational(1,2)
y=[]
previous=sp.Integer(0)
for i in range(9):
    previous=a*previous+1
    y.append(previous)
conv=[sum(a**(i-m) for m in range(i+1)) for i in range(9)]
print('递推=卷积:',y==conv,'前四项:',y[:4],'第8项:',y[8])
Y=1/((1-1/z)*(1-a/z))
print('阶跃初值/终值:',sp.limit(Y,z,sp.oo),sp.limit((1-1/z)*Y,z,1))
print('脉冲绝对和:',1/(1-abs(a)))
print('a1阶跃:',list(range(1,6)))
alt=1/(1+1/z)
print('交替反例前五项:',[(-1)**i for i in range(5)])
print('不满足条件的形式终值:',sp.limit((1-1/z)*alt,z,1))

notebooks.title: 单位圆频响与物理周期
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
theta=sp.symbols('theta', real=True)

cells.code:
a=sp.Rational(1,2)
H=1/(1-a*sp.exp(-sp.I*theta))
for angle in [0,sp.pi/2,sp.pi]:
    value=sp.simplify(H.subs(theta,angle))
    print('角度/H/幅值/相位:',angle,value,sp.simplify(sp.Abs(value)),sp.arg(value))
print('pi/2幅相小数:',sp.N(2/sp.sqrt(5),12),sp.N(-sp.atan(sp.Rational(1,2)),12))
print('Ts1分钟的周期:',2*sp.pi/(sp.pi/2))
print('2pi周期性余量:',sp.simplify(H.subs(theta,theta+2*sp.pi)-H))

notebooks.title: 模态采样与六题复算
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
import numpy as np
z=sp.symbols('z', nonzero=True)

cells.code:
a=sp.Rational(1,2)
print('题1:',1/(1-a/z),'ROC模z>1/2',sum(a**i for i in range(9)),2,sp.Rational(1,256))
print('题2左侧z1/4的80项近似:',sp.N(-sum(sp.Rational(1,2)**i for i in range(1,81)),12), '极限为-1;尾项绝对值2^-80')
print('题3:',2/(1-a/z),[4*a**(i+1) for i in range(4)])
print('题4:',[sum(a**m for m in range(i+1)) for i in range(3)],'通项2-(1/2)^k;初值1;终值2')
print('题5:',(4-2*sp.I)/5,2/sp.sqrt(5),-sp.atan(a),4)
print('题5交替形式终值:',sp.limit((1-1/z)/(1+1/z),z,1))
print('题6采样系数:',np.exp(-1),np.exp(-.5))
print('题6 a1阶跃:',[i+1 for i in range(5)])
